SHOPS.Willkommen.Einleitung: A shop here is an NPC or a place with goods in its inventory. You decide who gets to see it — not the players by clicking a token.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Punkt1: Goods and prices — drag items into the inventory, set a markup on the base price or a fixed price per entry, plus one line the shopkeeper says about it.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Punkt2: You show it — to everyone, to single players, or on the table's screen, where the shop stands large and pages by itself. Players can only open it themselves if you allow it.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Punkt3: Buying, on your terms — locked, on approval, or free. Payment comes from the chosen character's purse, change included, and every purchase lands in the market ledger afterwards.
SHOPS.Willkommen.Start: To begin: open an NPC, choose Set up shop in the sheet header and drag goods in.
SHOPS.Willkommen.ForgeZeile: Every module, its documentation and the German translations in one place — see them all
Off: a shop only appears when the gamemaster shows it. On: players may open a shop themselves, provided they can see the actor.
SHOPS.Einstellung.Blaettertakt.Name: Display view page turn (seconds)
SHOPS.Einstellung.Blaettertakt.Hinweis: How long one page stays on the table screen. The gamemaster can pause and step through pages at any time.
SHOPS.Kaufmodus.freigabe: Approval — the gamemaster confirms every purchase
SHOPS.Kaufmodus.direkt: Direct — the purchase goes through as soon as the money is there
SHOPS.Bogen.Name: Shop sheet
SHOPS.Bogen.KeineBegruessung: No greeting. It will appear at the top of the players' window.
SHOPS.Bogen.AuslageLeer: Nothing on the shelves yet. Drag items here from a compendium or the sidebar.
SHOPS.Bogen.Ankauf: What this shop pays for it
SHOPS.Bogen.FestpreisHinweis: Fixed price. Empty means: markup on the base price. A 0 means: free.
SHOPS.Bogen.Verborgen: Under the counter — players do not see it
SHOPS.Bogen.Dienst: Service — costs money, does not change hands
SHOPS.Bogen.WareLoeschenFrage: {name} will be removed from this shop. The item in the compendium is untouched.
SHOPS.Feld.AufschlagHinweis: Factor on the base price. 1.2 is twenty percent on top; 1 is the base price.
SHOPS.Feld.AnkaufHinweis: What this shop pays when buying, also as a factor. 0 means: buys nothing.
SHOPS.Feld.HoechstmengeHinweis: 0 means: no limit. Against the village bought empty.
SHOPS.Feld.EigeneKasseHinweis: Off: unlimited money, the normal case. On: the shop pays buy-backs from this till and can run dry.
SHOPS.Feld.BegruessungPlatzhalter: One or two sentences shown at the top of the players' window.
SHOPS.Vorzeigen.NiemandDa: Nobody is logged in to show it to.
SHOPS.Spieler.AuslageLeer: Nothing is on the shelves right now.
SHOPS.Spieler.KeineFigur: No character assigned — the purse appears once you have one.
SHOPS.Vorzeigen.NiemandSieht: Nobody is looking at it right now.
SHOPS.Spieler.BoerseHinweis: Your character's money. Purchases will later be charged by the gamemaster.
SHOPS.Feld.TokenbildHinweis: In case you place the shop on a map as a stall.
SHOPS.Zugriff.Erklaerung: Who may open this shop on their own. You can always show it to anyone — this only answers the other question. Either way the shop stays out of the players' actor sidebar.
SHOPS.Zugriff.niemand: Nobody — only when you show it
SHOPS.Zugriff.SchalterAus: "Players may open shops themselves" is off in the module settings. While it is, the selection here has no effect.
SHOPS.Feld.KopfbildWaehlen: Pick a picture of the shop interior
SHOPS.Feld.AusschnittHinweis: Moves which part of the picture shows at the top of the window. Left is up, right is down.
SHOPS.Angebot.Erklaerung: You are putting {name} in front of someone at a special price. The shop price would be {preis}.
SHOPS.Angebot.TextPlatzhalter: For you, since you cleared out my cellar …
SHOPS.Angebot.NiemandGewaehlt: Nobody selected — the offer went to no one.
SHOPS.Kauf.Frage: {menge}× {name} for {preis}, paid from the purse of {figur}.
SHOPS.Kauf.BrauchtFreigabe: This shop clears every purchase with the gamemaster first.
SHOPS.Kauf.WegVomTisch: The goods are no longer on display.
SHOPS.Kauf.KeineFigur: No character assigned — without one there is no purse to pay from.
SHOPS.Kauf.Gesperrt: This shop is not bought from directly — the gamemaster handles it at the table.
SHOPS.Kauf.NichtGenugDa: There is not that much left.
SHOPS.Kauf.ZuViel: This shop does not hand out that many at once.
SHOPS.Kauf.KeinSpielleiter: No purchase goes through without a gamemaster connected.
SHOPS.Kauf.Abgebrochen: The purchase was aborted. The gamemaster will find the reason in the market ledger.
SHOPS.Marktbuch.Name: Market ledger
SHOPS.Marktbuch.NochLeer: The market ledger appears with the first purchase.
SHOPS.Zugang.KeineLaeden: No shop is open for you right now.
SHOPS.Feld.KopfbildHinweis: Runs as a wide band above the shop — on your sheet and in the players window. A picture of the interior works best.
SHOPS.Verkauf.Hinweis: The shop pays less than it asks — that is its buy-back factor, not the shop price.
SHOPS.Verkauf.NichtsDabei: Nothing in your pack is anything this shop would take.
SHOPS.Verkauf.KauftNichtAn: This shop does not buy anything.
SHOPS.Verkauf.WegAusDemRucksack: You do not have that any more.
SHOPS.Verkauf.SoVieleNicht: You do not have that many.
SHOPS.Verkauf.LadenPleite: The shop does not have enough money for that.
SHOPS.Bogen.KauftAn: Does the shop take this back without asking? Everything else needs a sell request.
SHOPS.Feld.SpielraumHinweis: How far the price on a request may go up and down. 0.25 means a quarter above and below the usual buy-back value. Only you see those numbers.
SHOPS.Verkauf.NimmtErNicht: This shop does not simply take that — send a sell request.
SHOPS.Anfrage.KnopfHinweis: For anything the shop does not take without asking.
SHOPS.Anfrage.PackenHinweis: Pack up what you want to part with. The gamemaster sees it and names a price for the lot.
SHOPS.Anfrage.KorbLeer: You have not packed anything yet.
SHOPS.Anfrage.Unterwegs: The request is with the gamemaster.
SHOPS.Anfrage.UnterwegsHinweis: They can see what you offer and will name a price.
SHOPS.Anfrage.UntenHinweis: What they would still give if the party has soured on them.
SHOPS.Anfrage.UeblichHinweis: The regular buy-back value at this shop's factor.
SHOPS.Anfrage.ObenHinweis: What they would give if they think well of the party.
SHOPS.Anfrage.SatzPlatzhalter: That is all it is worth to me …
SHOPS.Buch.KnopfHinweis: What you bought and sold here
SHOPS.Buch.HinweisGM: Everything traded in this shop. Players only see their own lines here.
SHOPS.Buch.LeerGM: Nothing has been traded in this shop yet.
SHOPS.Buch.LeerSpieler: You have not bought or sold anything here yet.
SHOPS.Haendler.Ablegen: Drag an NPC here — they will stand in the shop and appear in the ledger.
SHOPS.Marktbuch.NichtsGefiltert: Nothing in the ledger for this shop yet.
SHOPS.Marktbuch.Fusshinweis: Failed attempts included — that is what it is for.
SHOPS.Marktbuch.LeerenFrage: Every line will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
SHOPS.Anfrage.KeinWert: This piece carries no price — name one yourself.
SHOPS.Anfrage.OhneLaden: no shop — these numbers are only a suggestion
SHOPS.Freigabe.Wartet: {menge}× {name}: your request is with the keeper of {laden}.
SHOPS.Freigabe.Abgelehnt: The keeper will not sell this.
SHOPS.Freigabe.SatzPlatzhalter: That one is not for you …
SHOPS.Zugriff.SzenenUeberall: None picked — the shop can be reached from any map.
SHOPS.Zugriff.SzenenGebunden: Only those looking at one of these maps can reach the shop.
SHOPS.Verknuepfung.KeinLadenText: {person} does not run a shop yet. Either it already exists and is simply not linked — or you create it now.
SHOPS.Verknuepfung.KeineLaedenDa: There is no shop to link yet. Create a new one.
SHOPS.Handel.KopfHinweis: What you tick here is what the player sees — nothing else from this sheet.
SHOPS.Handel.NimmtAnHinweis: The player may offer you something in turn. You name the price.
SHOPS.Handel.SatzPlatzhalter: For you I'll make a price …
SHOPS.Handel.AnbietenHinweis: Pack your things up and have a price named.
SHOPS.Handel.NichtsVorgelegt: Nothing is laid out for you right now.
SHOPS.Handel.NichtsDabei: This person carries nothing that could be traded.
SHOPS.Handel.NichtsGewaehlt: Nothing ticked, and nobody allowed to offer anything.
SHOPS.Handel.NichtMehrDa: That is not there any more.
SHOPS.Anfrage.NullIstKeinPreis: Zero is not a price. Name a number, or refuse the request.
SHOPS.Schau.GrossHinweis: The display view for the screen on the wall — no window, no buttons, readable from two metres.
SHOPS.Monitor.Name: Displays
SHOPS.Monitor.Hinweis: Which users are screens at the table. They are proposed for the display view when a shop is shown.
SHOPS.Monitor.Erklaerung: Ticked users are proposed for the display view when a shop is shown. The choice in the shop window still decides.
SHOPS.Monitor.AusInPerson: The answer currently comes from Ninjo's In-Person Tools. Who counts as a display is set there — this list does nothing while that module runs.
SHOPS.Schau.Sanduhr: Hourglass: how long this page still stands
SHOPS.Ansehen.KeineBeschreibung: Nothing further is written about this piece.
SHOPS.Einstellung.SchauLicht.Name: Display view: brightness
SHOPS.Einstellung.SchauLicht.Hinweis: Dark does not dazzle in a dimmed room. Parchment reads better on a television in daylight.
SHOPS.Szenenfeld.Ueberall: Drag a scene in here. None means: reachable everywhere.
SHOPS.Szenenfeld.SzeneHinweis: Drag a shop from the actor directory in here. It is then reachable only to whoever has this map in front of them. This is stored on the shop.
SHOPS.Szenenfeld.KeinLaden: No shop stands on this map.
SHOPS.Einstellung.Verzeichnisleiste.Name: Buttons in the actor directory
SHOPS.Einstellung.Verzeichnisleiste.Hinw: The bar at the foot of the directory. The market ledger stays reachable without it — from this settings page and from the ⋮ menu of any shop sheet.
SHOPS.Einstellung.Verzeichnisleiste.Beid: Both — new shop and market ledger
SHOPS.Marktbuch.MenuHinweis: Every purchase and sale across all shops, with a filter and the reasons for everything that failed.
SHOPS.Handel.AblehnenFrage: You hand back what {person} held out to you. The window goes away, and they are told.
